head_coach.name: Thomas Tuchel
head_coach.play_style_summary: Possession-dominant and system-first style focusing on high tactical control, defensive compactness, and intense counter-pressing. The team typically transitions to a 3-2-5 shape in possession to manage defensive transitions.

key_players.name: Jude Bellingham
key_players.performance_stats: Assigned the prestigious No. 10 shirt for the World Cup. A world-class midfielder who remains a primary focal point despite adapting to deeper tactical responsibilities under the new system.

key_players.name: Declan Rice
key_players.performance_stats: Anchors the central midfield with exceptional defensive work rate and tactical discipline, crucial to Tuchel's blueprint for structural balance.

key_players.name: Bukayo Saka
key_players.performance_stats: Assigned the No. 7 shirt for the World Cup. Continues to be highly explosive and consistent, providing valuable goal and assist contributions from the right wing.

injuries_and_absences.absence_reason: Ruled out of the 2026 World Cup due to a severe knee ligament injury.
